name: Budapest Liszt Ferenc International Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longest is 13L/31R, 3,707 m long and 45 m wide (13R/31L is 3,009 m × 45 m)

curfew.v: night quota, not a closure: 50 scheduled and non-scheduled commercial movements allowed 21:00–05:00 UTC (20:00–04:00 UTC in summer), of which only 6 between 23:00 and 04:00 UTC (22:00–03:00 UTC in summer)

noise.v: operators must send the airport operator the aircraft's noise certificate in advance; engine power tests banned at night
noise.quote: The airline or aircraft operator planning to use the airport is obliged to send to the airport operator in advance the noise certification of its aircraft.

notes: Source is the HungaroControl eAIP edition effective 14 May 2026, the newest one search found; later AIRAC editions (up to 1 Oct 2026) probably exist and could not be checked. Night times converted: 2100–0500 UTC winter (UTC+1) and 2000–0400 UTC summer (UTC+2) both give 22:00–06:00 local; the 6-movement core is 00:00–05:00 local. The quota covers commercial landings and take-offs; exemptions include emergency, humanitarian, medical and government flights. Sub-cap quote: 'Out of this, 6 movements between 2300 - 0400 (2200-0300).' AD 2.4 names no handling agents (fuel: BP Europa SE Hungary Branch, Airport Fuel Supply). No PPR or GA slot rule found in the part of the page read (last 4,000 characters, inside AD 2.22, not read).
